exception_title: Base Petition Not Approved Before Filing
exception_description: I-824 filed while underlying I-130/I-140 still pending; system issues receipt without checking base approval status.
I-824 requests consular notification to Embassy X but beneficiary resides in consular district of Embassy Y.
Two I-824 fees collected for same petition when petitioner files both duplicate-notice and consular-notify requests simultaneously.

exception_title: Beneficiary A-Number vs Receipt Number Swap
exception_description: I-824 submitted with receipt number in A-Number field; lookup fails and creates phantom petition record.
Petition already transferred to NVC; I-824 re-notifies consulate creating parallel track and duplicate interview scheduling.
Base approval notice date 06/07/YYYY OCR'd as July 6 instead of June 7; triggers wrong priority-date check.
Base petition revoked post-approval; I-824 proceeds to consulate without checking current petition status.
LLM treats I-824 for duplicate notice as new petition filing; generates new priority date in error.

exception_title: Multiple I-824 Same Receipt Same Requestor
exception_description: Petitioner submits three I-824s for same receipt; only one valid action; duplicates not deduplicated at intake.

exception_title: Consulate Notification Sent Before USCIS Transmittal
exception_description: DOS notified before USCIS transmits full file; consulate opens case without supporting documents.
Priority date on underlying petition was current at I-824 filing but retrogressed by the time consulate acts.
Attorney files I-824 without G-28 on file for that specific petition; no authorization check performed.
LLM advises I-824 appropriate when beneficiary now eligible to adjust status; should use I-485 instead.
Parent company petitioned; I-824 notification needed for subsidiary's consulate; entity routing logic fails.

exception_title: Consulate Code Not Updated in PIMS
exception_description: I-824 consulate change not reflected in PIMS; interview packet sent to old embassy.
